experiment: C7 confirmatory depth-two hierarchical Canaria recompilation

information_isolation.lower_pair_clusters: may use original pair-span targets during lower-IR construction
information_isolation.level1_pair_units: fit only from frozen lower-pair outputs
information_isolation.after_lower_ir_definition: original a4 forbidden as target for hierarchical fits/adaptations; allowed only for validation measurement and direct-original reference

conditions.hierarchical_no_level2_adapt: final C1234 fitted only from independently recompiled C12+C34 outputs
conditions.hierarchical_level2_joint_adapt: jointly adapt C12+C34 to lower IR only, freeze, then fit final C1234 only from adapted pair outputs
conditions.flat_lower_ir_single: fit final C1234 directly from lower IR
conditions.direct_original_single: fit matched final C1234 directly from original teacher; reference only

final_single_fairness: identical final initialization and minibatch RNG across final conditions within seed

P1.statistic: mean paired D = joint-depth-two original-NMSE - no-level2-adapt original-NMSE

P2.statistic: geometric mean R = joint-depth-two original-NMSE / flat-lower-IR original-NMSE

P3.statistic: joint-depth-two validation accuracy - flat-lower-IR validation accuracy

test_safeguard.evaluation: materialize/evaluate only after all fitting and validation metrics for seed
test_safeguard.statistic: joint-depth-two test accuracy - flat-lower-IR test accuracy

overall: CONFIRMATORY_PASS iff eligible_count>=8 and P1/P2/P3/test safeguard all pass; otherwise exact fail/stop without rescue
claim_boundary_if_pass: Scoped residual-MLP depth-two evidence only; not arbitrary-depth, lossless, cross-family depth-two, or LLM-scale.
